title.en: EU AI Act transparency rules become applicable
title.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案透明度规则开始适用

searchSummary.en: Article 50 transparency obligations and relevant supervisory powers under the EU AI Act became applicable on 2 August 2026.
searchSummary.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案第 50 条透明度义务及相关监督权于 2026 年 8 月 2 日开始适用。

summary.en: On 2 August 2026, the EU AI Act’s Article 50 transparency obligations became applicable. The staged milestone covers specified direct human-AI interactions and synthetic-content disclosure or marking duties, while high-risk-system obligations remain on later dates.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 2 日，欧盟 AI 法案第 50 条透明度义务开始适用。这一分阶段节点涵盖特定直接人机交互及合成内容的披露或标记义务；高风险系统义务仍适用更晚的日期。

narrative.en: The European Commission published guidance and described the new enforcement stage as applying to certain interactive AI systems, synthetic content, deepfakes and public-interest text. Providers and deployers retain different obligations, and legacy generative systems have a limited transition for one machine-readable-marking duty. This is a concrete compliance milestone, not evidence that all providers are compliant, that authorities have already imposed penalties, or that the AI Act’s deferred high-risk rules have taken effect.
narrative.zhHans: 欧盟委员会发布了指南，并将这一新的执行阶段说明为适用于某些交互式 AI 系统、合成内容、深度伪造和涉及公共利益的文本。提供方与部署方承担不同义务；既有生成式系统对一项机器可读标记义务享有有限过渡期。这是一个具体的合规节点，不代表所有提供方已经合规、主管机构已经作出处罚，也不代表被延后的高风险规则已经生效。

description.en: Transparency requirements move AI interaction and synthetic-content disclosure from future planning into an active compliance obligation for in-scope systems.
description.zhHans: 透明度要求使人机交互和合成内容披露从未来规划转变为相关系统正在适用的合规义务。

description.en: The staged rules create immediate classification, disclosure and documentation work for organisations while boundaries and transition details are interpreted.
description.zhHans: 在适用边界和过渡细节仍需解释的情况下，分阶段规则为组织带来了即时的分类、披露和文档工作。

text.en: Article 50 transparency obligations under the EU AI Act became applicable on 2 August 2026, including notice duties for specified human-AI interactions and disclosure or marking duties for specified synthetic content.
text.zhHans: 欧盟 AI 法案第 50 条透明度义务于 2026 年 8 月 2 日开始适用，其中包括特定人机交互的告知义务，以及特定合成内容的披露或标记义务。

text.en: The application milestone makes transparency compliance an immediate operational issue for in-scope providers and deployers, while giving competent authorities applicable supervisory roles.
text.zhHans: 这一适用节点使透明度合规成为相关提供方和部署方的即时运营问题，并赋予主管机构相应的监督职责。

text.en: The milestone does not mean that all AI Act obligations are simultaneously in force: high-risk-system obligations were deferred, and eligible pre-existing generative systems have a limited transition for Article 50(2) marking duties.
text.zhHans: 这一节点并不意味着 AI 法案的所有义务同时生效：高风险系统义务已被延后，符合条件的既有生成式系统对第 50 条第 2 款标记义务享有有限过渡期。
